parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Separate variables correctly and attempt integration of one side - B1. Obtain the term $\tan y$, or equivalent - B1. Obtain a term of the form $k\ln\cos x$, or equivalent - M1. Obtain $-4\ln\cos x$, or equivalent - A1. Use $x=0$ and $y=\frac14\pi$ in a solution containing $a\tan y$ and $b\ln\cos x$ to evaluate a constant, or as limits - M1. Obtain a correct solution in any form, e.g. $\tan y=4\ln\sec x+1$ - A1. Substitute $y=\frac13\pi$ in a solution containing terms $a\tan y$ and $b\ln\cos x$, and use a correct method to find $x$ - M1. Obtain $x=0.587$ - A1. Total: 8.
